title: Rates and Speed
seo_title: Grade 7 Rates and Speed Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 7)
standard_text: Identify and explain the uses of rates; solve problems involving rates (e.g., speed).
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 rates worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: unit rates, best buys, speed, distance and time and converting rates. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Unit rate: the amount for 1 unit.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A rate compares two quantities with different units: ₱/kg, km/h, words per minute.
  • A unit rate is the amount for 1 unit: ₱150 for 3 kg is ₱50 per kg.
  • Speed = distance ÷ time. Distance = speed × time. Time = distance ÷ speed.
  • Change minutes to hours before using km/h: 30 minutes = 0.5 hour.

Examples

Example

120 km in 1.5 hours

120 ÷ 1.5

Answer: 80 km/h

Example

₱255 for 3 kg

255 ÷ 3

Answer: ₱85 per kg

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Dividing the wrong waySpeed = distance ÷ time, not time ÷ distance.
Minutes as hours45 minutes = 0.75 hour.
Comparing totalsCompare the price for the same amount.
